## Workflow and problem

Describe the task you are trying to complete and the current limitation.

## Proposed behavior

Give a concrete input and expected result. Explain how a user would access the
change through the proxy, SDK, CLI, or dashboard.

## Alternatives and scope

Describe any workaround and why it is insufficient. Note compatibility,
traffic integrity, accounting, or privacy implications.

Taximeter is local-first and does not hold funds, handle keys, sign or settle
payments, provide hosted accounts, or collect telemetry. Requests should preserve
those boundaries.
